name: fhir4ds-omop-mapping
description: FHIR R4 -> OMOP CDM v5.5 tables as a ViewDefinition library. Rev-2 architecture: the STANDARD MONOLITHIC ConceptMap resource ships as the converter contract; the S1 conceptmap VD flattens it (materialized as the omop.omop_conceptmap join target); event VDs join the VIEW via Join.view (spec composition semantics). Unions + projections compose through the generic fhir4ds.viewdef.runner. Materialization order is INFERRED from Join.view references (zero-config); 'materialize' remains an optional override.

views.conceptmap-view: ConceptMap resources -> flat mapping rows (THE join target; materialized as omop.omop_conceptmap)
views.person-source-view: Patient -> person_source (reshape only; joined and keyed by the person SQLQuery)

conceptmap_source.canonical_form: STANDARD MONOLITHIC ConceptMap (all groups in one resource) — the converter contract
conceptmap_source.athena_converter: medterm4ds side emits the same monolithic form; flattening happens query-side via the conceptmap VD (rev 2)

v54_variant.delta: v5.5 adds only optional fields (observation.value_as_date, unit_source_concept_id, value_as_source_concept_id; measurement.value_as_source_concept_id; specimen visit FKs) and vocabulary metadata tables — none in this spine scope. A v5.4 manifest flags the observation/measurement views to drop those columns.

etl_assumptions: type_concept_id defaults: 32810 (EHR record) family per event table; per-branch drug types 38000177/38000175/38000180; condition category -> 38000245/43542353
provider/care_site integer FKs left 0 (FHIR carries references, not stable integers) — documented policy
person/visit/PK ids: xxhash-style positive 63-bit hash of the FHIR id string (runner projections)
observation_period is ETL-defined per THEMIS (aggregate derivation, not a row mapping) — not in the VD library v1
